posts.title: The Correct Wines
posts.description: I’ve listened to it many times; Vincent Price’s spoken word album Wine Is Elegance is just great. posts.title: Sex in Public
posts.description: It’s been a long week. I feel like the public knows a lot more about a CEO’s sex life than we all needed to know, don’t you?
